fusions.name: Parting Yelp
fusions.desc: Barks a pulse that deals 7 resonating damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of the damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Set at Odds
fusions.desc: Seizes up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles and turns them against each other for 5 seconds. Each takes 10 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Take Them Both Sides
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a shot flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
